The design brief / Self-initiated study

The brief.

An illustrative solar-planning publication that explains array capacity, generation assumptions and financial examples through clear diagrams.

The challenge

Solar planning combines technical capacity, generation assumptions and financial examples that can easily be confused.

Design direction.

Use explanatory diagrams and a clear separation between capacity figures, assumptions and illustrative financial examples.

More reports & research ↗

Source and format.

Intended outcome

Help readers compare planning information while retaining the distinction between modelled and actual outcomes.
